fields.Front: ES2240F: what percentage of the grade is the midterm, and what does it cover?
fields.Back: 20%. Two-hour written exam, online with Proctortrack, October 24; covers Units 1 and 2 (to the end of Chapter 9). Make-up October 27 only with academic counsellor permission.

fields.Front: ES2240F: how are the scientific report marks split and when are the parts due?
fields.Back: 40% total: Introduction and reference list 10% due October 6, 1:00 pm; final report (2500 words) 30% due December 1, 1:00 pm.

fields.Front: ES2240F: how many graded quizzes are offered, how many must you complete, and by when?
fields.Back: 9 quizzes; complete 7 for full credit (missing ones count as zero); all must be submitted by the last day of classes, not the exam day. Quizzes are worth 10%.

fields.Front: ES2240F: what are the late penalties for the scientific report?
fields.Back: 2% if submitted within two hours after the deadline; then 10% per late day for up to 5 days (weekends included); nothing accepted after that.

fields.Text: The ES2240F final exam is worth {{c1::30%}}, is {{c2::non-cumulative}}, and covers the Unit 3 Introduction to Chapter {{c3::20}}.

fields.Front: Who developed most of the ES2240F course content, and who is the Fall 2026 instructor?
fields.Back: Content: Prof. Neil D. MacRae. Instructor: Dr. Sean Shieh (sshieh@uwo.ca).
